content.text: The installed code doesn't use the word "beta", but it still marks the feature as experimental. In wrangler 4.148.0, automatic provisioning sits behind a hidden `--experimental-provision` flag (alias `--x-provision`), described as "Experimental: Enable automatic resource provisioning". That flag defaults to `true`, so `wrangler deploy` provisions resources unless you pass `--no-x-provision`. The project's lessons note that from 4.113.0 this also covers Queue, Dispatch Namespace and Flagship bindings. To find out whether Cloudflare officially calls it beta or generally available, check their changelog or docs; I didn't look at those.
